$comment: Fixes and additions on top of the sources. patches: fields merged over a source card, keyed by print ID ("PBL-42") or, to fix a wrong number, the source's own ID ("zsv10pt5-80"). sets / cards: sets and cards the sources haven't added yet, in pokemon-tcg-data's format; cards are keyed by set ID. The build warns when an entry becomes redundant.

rules: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn't have a Rule Box, the attacks it uses do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.text: Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.
